name: overture
summary: Overture pairs sculptural refinement with layered textures. The seater is wrapped in a rich textile that offers tactile warmth, while the armrests feature a sleek metal frame encased in smooth hard leather. A brushed nickel stainless steel back detail provides an elegant, contemporary contrast that completes the silhouette with grace. 87x73x70
